opening.argument: The video presents a front-running bot that directs viewers to Remix, connect a wallet, send at least 0.4 BNB, and activate the bot contract. Its central promise is unusually specific: after a few minutes, viewers are told they will see 10x profit, while the description claims that 90% of the profit will automatically return to their wallet. The workflow is therefore a direct request to transfer funds into an automated trading process tied to a contract address, accompanied by a promised return. The like-and-subscribe language is ordinary audience engagement, not a stated financial condition. The combination of the wallet transfer, contract instructions, and promised rapid multiple establishes the offered scheme as deceptive financial solicitation.

citations.quote: automatically transacts back to your wallet 90% of the profit.
